meta.status_detail: Mechanically migrated 2026-09-18 from the JOURNAL_STYLE_PRESETS dict literal in docs_intel.py (round 2, proposal 64266f13, dated 2026-09-11) as part of the JSON-preset externalization work (proposal 3b93b7ef) -- values and evidence carried over verbatim from the real in-code comment, not regenerated. De Gruyter publishes many distinct journal families (Mouton, STEM, law, etc.), each with its own style sheet, so the values captured here are a conservative cross-imprint floor rather than a single blanket fact.

source.citation: degruyterbrill.com Instructions-for-Authors (Discrete Mathematics and Applications); De Gruyter Mouton journal style-sheet PDFs
source.note: Vancouver preferred, Harvard or Chicago author-date acceptable for others -- varies by publication, hence not_fixed.

source.citation: degruyterbrill.com Instructions-for-Authors (Discrete Mathematics and Applications); De Gruyter Mouton journal style-sheet PDFs
source.note: figure resolution requirements vary widely by imprint (300-1200 dpi depending on figure type and journal family); the STEM guidance page's own blanket floor of 300 dpi is used here as the most conservative cross-imprint figure -- the style-sheet PDFs were consulted for corroboration of the range, not as the source of this specific value.
